summary: KB Article Feedback Widget feature tested - ALL TESTS PASSED. Backend APIs (POST/GET feedback, admin articles with stats) working correctly. Frontend widget displays properly, handles button clicks, shows correct confirmation messages, and resets on article navigation.

backend_api_tests.GET_feedback_stats: PASS - returns {total, helpful, unhelpful} with correct values
backend_api_tests.GET_admin_articles_feedback: PASS - includes feedback_total and feedback_helpful per article

frontend_widget_tests.shows_was_this_helpful_text: PASS - 'Was this article helpful?' text displayed
frontend_widget_tests.thumbs_up_button: PASS - data-testid='feedback-helpful-btn' found with ThumbsUp icon
frontend_widget_tests.thumbs_down_button: PASS - data-testid='feedback-unhelpful-btn' found with ThumbsDown icon
frontend_widget_tests.no_click_confirmation: PASS - Shows 'Thanks for letting us know. We'll improve this article.'
frontend_widget_tests.widget_reset_on_navigation: PASS - Buttons reappear when navigating to different article
frontend_widget_tests.buttons_hidden_after_submit: PASS - Cannot submit twice, buttons replaced by confirmation

admin_feedback_stats.admin_ui_requires_oauth: EXPECTED - KB Editor requires Google OAuth (verified via curl)

data_persistence.counts_increment_correctly: PASS - Total and helpful/unhelpful counts increment

critical_code_review_comments: Good implementation: FeedbackWidget component properly uses useEffect to reset state when slug changes
Good: data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (feedback-widget, helpful-btn, unhelpful-btn, thanks)
Good: Admin sidebar shows color-coded helpfulness badges (green >=70%, amber >=40%, red <40%)
seed_data_creation: Added feedback votes via API testing to articles: welcome, first-app, plans-and-credits, voice-mode, github-integration, faqs, how-apps-work
context_for_next_testing_agent: KB Feedback feature fully implemented. Public widget at /docs/{slug} with data-testid selectors. Backend stores feedback in 'kb_feedback' collection. Admin KB Editor sidebar shows % badges next to articles with feedback (data-testid='feedback-stat-{slug}'). Admin panel requires Google OAuth - cannot be tested via curl/Playwright without manual login.
